questions.subject: Biology
questions.q: Osmoreceptors are sensitive to changes in ionic concentrations and volumes of body fluids. Which among the following best describes the function of these osmoreceptors?
options: They stimulate hypothalamus to facilitate the release of the anti-diuretic hormone and increase water reabsorption.
They stimulate atrial wall to release atrial natriuretic factor to induce vasodilation and reduce blood pressure.
They stimulate pituitary gland to facilitate the secretion of mineralocorticoids to adjust the changes in mineral composition of the body fluid.
They stimulate renin production to induce vasoconstriction and increase blood pressure.

questions.subject: Biology
questions.q: Which one of the following correctly describes the mode of action of Follicle Stimulating Hormone (FSH) and estrogen?
options: FSH interacts with membrane-bound receptor and generates cyclic AMP, while estrogen interacts with intracellular receptor and regulates gene expression
Both FSH and estrogen regulate gene expression via intracellular receptors
FSH interacts with intracellular receptor and generates cyclic AMP, while estrogen interacts with membrane-bound receptor and regulates cellular metabolism
Both FSH and estrogen regulate cellular metabolism via membrane-bound receptors
questions.solution:
FSH is a proteinaceous hormone that cannot pass through the lipid bilayer of the cell membrane. It binds to specific membrane-bound receptors on the target cell surface, leading to the generation of second messengers like cyclic AMP (cAMP), which in turn regulate cellular metabolism.

Estrogen is a steroid hormone and is lipid-soluble. It easily diffuses across the cell membrane and binds to intracellular receptors (usually in the nucleus). The hormone-receptor complex then interacts with the genome to regulate gene expression or chromosome function.

Answer: FSH interacts with membrane-bound receptor and generates cyclic AMP, while estrogen interacts with intracellular receptor and regulates gene expression

questions.subject: Biology
questions.q: Which one of the following statements about second messengers is correct?
options: These are secondary metabolites produced by plants in response to an infection.
These are molecules generated during secondary steps of hormone signaling.
These are signaling molecules generated during secondary infections in animals.
These are proteins which help digest the secondary metabolites from plants.
